title: One watch history per person, and Continue watching, from the server.
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need."; "Their place is always one press away.". Split from JS-186 (D-20261127-domains-tasks).
acceptanceCriteria: Each person has one watch history per title, across devices and versions.

Continue watching is decided by the server and is the same on every device: titles in progress and each show's next episode, including a show the viewer had caught up on when a new episode arrives; a title not played for longer than the viewer's own setting leaves it; removing a title keeps the viewer's place (#101, #233).
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
notes: Criteria are JS-186's criteria 3 and 4 plus the contract criterion. Phase M1 chosen (split from JS-186, M1); ux flag chosen: true.
